title: supervisor.json v1: the app's session history of one playthrough
description: <runtime>/sessions/<playthrough>/supervisor.json, written by bg3play.supervisor (write_history) after each session it ran: one row per SessionResult. A row with session "?" is a session that never started (no agent, no game, refused spend): it is in the history but doesn't count as played. Readers skip fields they don't know.

game_deaths.description: each game death the session recovered from (or refused to): its OOM cause, "" = not out of memory
